A [[Gender|male]] [[Rodian]] worked as a '''fruit vendor''' in the settlement of [[Kothal]] on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]]<ref name="Fighter Flight" /> in the [[Standard year|year]] [[5 BBY]].<ref name="Star Wars: Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> When the [[Spectres|rebels]] [[Garazeb Orrelios]] and [[Ezra Bridger]] arrived in Kothal [[Attack on Imperial Troop Transports|searching for supplies]], the vendor was selling [[fruit]]s from his stall including [[thorn pear]]s and [[jogan fruit]]s. He had [[Color|green]] skin and black [[eye]]s and wore a brown [[Clothing|brown]] shirt while at his stall. While trying to sell his product he spoke in [[Huttese]].<ref name="Fighter Flight" />

==Behind the scenes==
The vendor first appeared in "[[Fighter Flight]],"<ref name="Fighter Flight" /> the fourth episode of the [[Star Wars Rebels Season One|first season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'', which premiered on [[Disney XD]] on [[October 13]], [[2015]].<ref name="Insider 156">{{InsiderCite|156|Star Wars Rebels Recounted|''Star Wars Rebels'' Recounted}}</ref>
